membership_model: one continuous probability in [0,1] per frozen RGB Gaussian and query
observation_operator: exact frozen front-to-back contribution, alpha-conditioned scalar membership

optimization.loss: uniform probability BCE plus 0.5 soft Dice

result_interpretation: The best constructed feasible membership is a lower bound on the unknown optimum. A lower bound above the reproduced reference rules out the frozen carrier as a hard limit; a lower bound below it is inconclusive.
